Name: Tidelight Harbor
Author: NogitsuneGurl
Description:
[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/5454d3d4-bdbd-437d-91c5-a1d87521236e_cb9c0e60dc88cfe7-compatible.gif[/img]

[size=6][b][color=#aaf0f4]🏮 Tidelight Harbor 🌊[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][i]sea glass, driftwood and night market lanterns… a cozy harbor home that glows after dark ✨[/i][/size][/center]

Hi hi! 💜 I made you [b]59 pieces[/b] of seaside furniture and lanterns for a lantern-lit harbor home and its back-alley night market, indoors and out, plus [b]3 wallpapers and 3 floors[/b] 🏡🌊 Everything is sold at [b]Robin's[/b], and in the Furniture Framework version [b]24 pieces glow in their own color[/b] at night 🌙

[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/12c9d589-133e-44a3-be67-e0b68ac31561_fc2a5984ca2e5276-compatible.gif[/img][/center]

[size=4][b]🧺 What's inside[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]💡 [b]24 lights:[/b] lanterns, sconces, a lighthouse lamp and a fire bowl, each with its own glow[/*]
[*]🐠 animated aquariums and a crackling galley stove · 🛏️ a real bed you can sleep in · 🧰 a sea chest that stores[/*]
[*]🏮 a whole night market for outside: gate, stall, noodle cart, fortune-teller's booth and wishing well[/*]
[/list][spoiler]
[b]🌊 All 59 pieces[/b]
[b]💡 Lights:[/b] Sea Glass Lantern, Paper Moon Floor Lamp, Jellyfish Lantern Jar, Lighthouse Lamp, Koi Lantern, Tidelight Lantern Garland, Anglerfish Desk Lamp, Harbor Fire Bowl, Driftwood Lantern Cluster, Faded Paper Lantern Tower, Mossy Stone Lantern, Market Street Lantern, Festival Lantern Line
[b]🖼️ On the wall:[/b] Glass Float Sconce, Scallop Shell Sconce, Moonlit Porthole, Back-Alley Market Sign, Alley Noren Doorway, Moth & Lantern Wall Bracket, Fishing Net & Floats, Koi Streamer Banner, Old Harbor Map, Seashell Wreath
[b]🐠 Always moving:[/b] Abyssal Jelly Aquarium, Tidelight Aquarium, Harbor Galley Stove
[b]🛏️ Home:[/b] Shell Canopy Bed, Driftwood Chair, Rope-Wrapped Stool, Scallop Shell Armchair, Driftwood Bench, Harbor Sofa, Driftwood Dining Table, Tide Pool Coffee Table, Sea Glass Side Table, Net-Mender's Long Table, Seashell Dresser, Barnacle Sea Chest, Driftwood Bookcase, Firefly Bottle Shelf, Great Wave Folding Screen
[b]🌀 Rugs:[/b] Lantern Market Rug, Koi Pond Rug, Braided Rope Rug, Sea Glass Mosaic Rug
[b]🏮 Night market:[/b] Lantern-Lit Curio Table, Night Tea Stall Bench, Lantern Crates & Sleeping Cat, Fortune-Teller's Booth, Lantern Market Stall, Night Market Gate, Lantern Noodle Cart, Koi Wishing Well
[b]⚓ Harbor and garden:[/b] Harbor Buoy, Rope & Anchor Post, Stacked Lobster Pots, Potted Sea Kelp, Driftwood Succulent Planter, Sea Lavender Urn
[b]🧱 Walls and floors:[/b] Driftwood Wainscot Wall, Night Harbor Wallpaper, Sea Glass Tile Wall, Weathered Deck Floor, Shell Mosaic Floor, Harbor Cobble Floor[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]🏡 Optional: Tidelight Harbor House[/b][/size]
A matching farmhouse in sea-glass clapboard and midnight shingles, with curtained, trimmed windows, a net-float garland and night market lanterns, in the [b]Files[/b] tab under [b]Optional files[/b]. The decor works fine without it.
[list]
[*]It replaces the farmhouse look at [b]every upgrade level[/b], with its own paint areas for Robin's paint menu. Use only one farmhouse retexture at a time ⚠️[/*]
[*]❄️ Snowy in winter, and 🌙 the windows glow a dim amber after dark. Moved your farmhouse? Set [b]WindowGlow[/b] to false in config.json (WinterSnow turns the snow off).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🛠️ Requirements & install[/b][/size]
Needs [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Furniture Framework 3.3+[/b] or [b]Content Patcher 2.9+[/b] (pick one main file) · works on existing saves 💾
[spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], then Furniture Framework or Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download [b]one[/b] main file: [b]Furniture Framework[/b] (glowing lights and animations) or [b]Content Patcher[/b] (no extra framework).[/*]
[*]Unzip it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. Coming from an older version? Delete any older Tidelight folders first.[/*]
[*]Want the house too? Unzip [b]Tidelight Harbor House[/b] into Mods the same way.[/*]
[*]Start the game and visit [b]Robin's[/b] 🪵💜[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]❓ Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]🤝 The decor only adds new furniture, so it plays nice with other decor mods.[/*]
[*]🏡 House not changing? Remove other farmhouse retextures, then sleep once.[/*]
[*]📸 Gallery pictures are real screenshots from my test farm.[/*]
[/list]
[b]💌 Sharing:[/b] Enjoy it in your game, screenshots and streams! Please don't reupload, sell or bundle the set, and ask me before sharing edits or reusing the art 🙏

[center][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/12c9d589-133e-44a3-be67-e0b68ac31561_fc2a5984ca2e5276-compatible.gif[/img][/center]

💜 Made with love by NogitsuneGurl · every pixel drawn in my very own [b]Pixel Loom[/b] 🧶✨ Found a bug? Tell me in the Posts or Bugs tab with your game + mod version 💜
